description: This file declares functions related to managing Cisco Hotspot SSID and associated devices, including retrieval of entry counts, entries, and parameter values, as well as synchronization and update checks.

methods.name: HsSsid_GetEntryCount
methods.description: Retrieves the number of SSID entries.

methods.name: HsSsid_GetEntry
methods.description: Retrieves a specific SSID entry by index.

methods.name: HsSsid_GetParamStringValue
methods.description: Gets the string value of a specified SSID parameter.

methods.name: HsAssoDev_GetEntryCount
methods.description: Retrieves the number of associated device entries.

methods.name: HsAssoDev_GetEntry
methods.description: Retrieves a specific associated device entry by index.

methods.name: HsAssoDev_IsUpdated
methods.description: Checks if the associated device data has been updated.

methods.name: HsAssoDev_GetParamStringValue
methods.description: Gets the string value of a specified associated device parameter.

methods.name: HsAssoDev_GetParamUlongValue
methods.description: Gets the unsigned long value of a specified associated device parameter.
